ideas.title: More dinner. Same broiler.
ideas.targetAudience: Home cooks increasing a familiar dinner while accommodating dietary needs.
ideas.whyWatch: The ingredient amount grows; the broiler does not. A concise visual plan shows the overlooked consequence.
ideas.visibleEvent: Photographic dinner context gives way to exact quantity math, two tactile foil sheets in sequence, sauce finishing and a focused recipe invitation.
ideas.payoff: Understand the specific real two-batch method, then know which Original to open and make fit.

variants.caption:
More dinner. Same broiler.

This RecipeFix example takes Chicken Tikka Masala from 4 to 6: 1½ → 2¼ lb of chicken, two foil-lined sheets, broiled one at a time. Then each batch finishes in simmering sauce.

Try the Chicken Tikka Masala Original → Make it fit. Set your needs and servings, and read the full method before cooking.

Recorded Dairy-Free request, October 21, 2026. Licensed serving inspiration, not a cooking test.
